title: (DO NOT REOPEN) editcap: if -T was specified, change the linktype of all interfaces.
description:
Don't just change the linktype of the file (if it has one) and the
linktypes of all the packets, change the linktype of all interfaces as
well.

Fixes #17520.


(cherry picked from commit 158810c7134f593cf9ac7da78161a8458eb1b0ef)
